lines.text: I'd had some of those windows open since March.
Three of them were the same note. I closed two.
Then I wrote a rule. Chatter opens on two.
It isn't closed. It's on two.
I returned the drill. I'd had it four years. He said I didn't need to.
Nobody else wanted to take the minutes.
Number fourteen's hedge is six foot two. The limit is six feet.
I started recording the height after our second conversation.
Nobody corrected the minutes. I circulated them again.
Number fourteen leaves a light on.
